item.title: Self-Hosted PostgreSQL Logical Replication: pglogical vs wal2json vs pgoutput
item.description: PostgreSQL offers two replication paradigms: physical (streaming) replication, which copies entire database clusters byte-for-byte, and logical replication, which replicates individual tables, rows, and columns at the SQL level. While physical replication is ideal for read scaling and disaster recovery, logical replication enables selective data synchronization, multi-master setups, zero-downtime migrations, and change data capture (CDC) pipelines.

item.title: SymmetricDS vs Debezium vs Canal: Self-Hosted Data Replication & CDC Guide 2026
item.description: When your application grows beyond a single database, keeping data synchronized across systems becomes a critical infrastructure challenge. Whether you need real-time analytics, disaster recovery, or multi-region data distribution, choosing the right self-hosted data replication tool can save your team hundreds of engineering hours.

item.title: Debezium vs Maxwell vs Canal: Best Self-Hosted CDC Tools 2026
item.description: Change Data Capture (CDC) is the backbone of modern data pipelines. Instead of running expensive, slow batch jobs that poll your database every few minutes, CDC streams every INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE in real time — giving downstream systems an exact replica of your data with sub-second latency.
